IttleCorner - Third-party asset credits
=======================================

Every model, texture or sound that did not come from this project is listed here,
with where it came from and its license. Add a line when you import something new.
Folder names are where the files live inside Assets/ThirdParty/.

STATUS KEY:  [imported] in the project   [planned] chosen but not downloaded yet

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Quaternius - LowPoly Modular Sci-Fi Environments            [imported]  Quaternius_SciFi
  Source:  https://opengameart.org/content/lowpoly-modular-sci-fi-environments
  Author:  Quaternius (https://quaternius.com)
  License: CC0 1.0 (public domain), per the download page
  Used for: walls, floors and props for the hero institute rooms

Kenney - Modular Space Kit                                  [imported]  Kenney_ModularSpace
  Source:  https://opengameart.org/content/modular-space-kit
  Author:  Kenney (https://kenney.nl)
  License: CC0 1.0 (public domain)
  Used for: snap-together wall and floor pieces

Kenney - Space Station Kit                                  [imported]  Kenney_SpaceStation
  Source:  https://opengameart.org/content/space-station-kit
  Author:  Kenney (https://kenney.nl)
  License: CC0 1.0 (public domain)
  Used for: entry hall props (hologram table, lockers, reception desk) via the scene builder

Kenney - Furniture Kit                                      [imported]  Kenney_Furniture
  Source:  https://opengameart.org/content/furniture-kit
  Author:  Kenney (https://kenney.nl)
  License: CC0 1.0 (public domain)
  Used for: lockers, desks, lounge furniture

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CC0 needs no credit, but we list it anyway to say thank you.
